page.notes: Public adult-media MPA with an age-assurance interstitial, category/search listings, video detail pages, account modal and abuse-report flow.

artifacts.caption: home preferences
artifacts.condition: prefers-color-scheme: dark; prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; prefers-contrast: more

artifacts.caption: preferences probe
artifacts.condition: prefers-color-scheme: dark; prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; prefers-contrast: more

checkOutcomes.method: evaluate and screenshot under prefers-color-scheme: dark
checkOutcomes.evidence: Emulated dark preference left color-scheme as normal and the body at rgb(238,238,238) with rgb(51,51,51) text.
Two 5.5 second animations remained active under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

checkOutcomes.method: contrast preference probe plus Lighthouse contrast audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Under prefers-contrast: more the page retained its normal palette, while Lighthouse separately found text ratios as low as 2.27:1.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/CSS platform inspection across homepage, category, search and detail routes
checkOutcomes.evidence: The MPA exposes route and filter changes but platform inspection found no authored view-transition CSS or navigation transition treatment.
The representative pages contain no scrollytelling, parallax, reveal, or other scroll-linked motion to implement.
checkOutcomes.reason: The representative pages contain no scrollytelling, parallax, reveal, or other scroll-linked motion to implement.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No swipe, drag, pull-to-reveal, carousel, or gesture-driven primary control was present on the audited paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No swipe, drag, pull-to-reveal, carousel, or gesture-driven primary control was present on the audited paths.

checkOutcomes.method: long-page layout and CSS feature inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage is over 4,000 CSS pixels tall, but CSS inspection found no scroll-state query, scroll timeline, or progress treatment; chrome remains static.
No tooltip or anchored transient menu was needed on the representative paths; the login surface is a modal flow, not an anchored popover.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip or anchored transient menu was needed on the representative paths; the login surface is a modal flow, not an anchored popover.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Descriptive navigation labels, current-page headings, search-result headings, and the 404 Return to Home action provide clear orientation.

checkOutcomes.method: load screenshots and fixed-overlay geometry probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Load screenshots are fully obscured by a verification interstitial, and DOM inspection also found two fixed offer frames at z-index 2147483647 occupying 343 by 255 pixels. Age assurance is legitimate, but the additional fixed offers are not content-first.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM inspection of dialog and fixed overlays
checkOutcomes.evidence: The login UI is an ad-hoc div with role=dialog and manual Bootstrap dismissal rather than a native dialog; fixed third-party offer frames are also custom top-layer UI.
Two fixed offer frames and a persistent domain banner compete with page content, with the offer frames using the maximum z-index.
At 360 by 800 the layout reported scrollWidth 360, clientWidth 360, zero horizontal overflow, and a viewport meta tag.
CSS feature inspection found no @container or container-type usage for repeated video cards and navigation components.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse target-size audit and DOM geometry probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found undersized touch targets, including a 151 by 16 pixel footer link, and the platform probe counted 15 rendered controls below 24 pixels in one dimension.
The title, H1, labelled filters, categories and video-card link text make the browsing purpose and next actions explicit.
A representative browse journey was reachable through Categories, search results, and a content detail URL with descriptive internal links and no account wall in the server-rendered content.
A nonexistent route shows Page not found, a concise explanation, Return to Home, and relevant alternatives; invalid complaint fields show specific messages and aria-describedby associations.
Lighthouse measured LCP 6.8 seconds and the trace measured LCP 5.10 seconds; TBT was low and CLS was zero, but LCP is outside the good range.
The mobile layout observer and Lighthouse both reported CLS 0 with no observed shifts.
The trace recorded two long tasks, longest 57.89 ms, and only 9.33 ms total blocking time; Lighthouse TBT was 40 ms.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against script attributes in DOM
checkOutcomes.evidence: The HAR found 71 requests, six very-high-priority parser stylesheets, parser-inserted scripts without async/defer, and third-party requests taking up to 9.0 seconds.
Lighthouse estimated 235 KiB unused JavaScript and 11 KiB unused CSS; multiple push, ad, payment and challenge bundles dominate the waste.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audits and image primitive
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found two focusable links without discernible names; the image audit also found two images without alt text.
Lighthouse found repeated 12 px metadata at 4.47:1 and green ratings at only 2.27:1 against white.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse structural audits and active focus probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse passed heading order and button naming; a keyboard focus probe showed a visible dotted outline plus box shadow on the skip link.

checkOutcomes.method: mobile screenshot, layout and DOM text inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Primary headings and body copy remained unclipped with no horizontal overflow on mobile; no text clipping was observed in the audited layouts.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse target-size audit and mobile layout
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport reflow succeeds, but Lighthouse failed target size and found a 151 by 16 pixel footer link with inadequate spacing.
Lighthouse captured a failed third-party resource with ERR_RESPONSE_HEADERS_MULTIPLE_LOCATION.
The document has a valid doctype and charset, but the image audit found two missing dimensions, seven oversized images, 45 legacy-format images and two missing alt values.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse BFCache audit and overlay/frame probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reported the page was not eligible for BFCache because an iframe navigation never completed; the page also loads many fragile cross-origin frames.
Homepage and detail pages expose descriptive unique titles and meta descriptions in raw HTML.
Lighthouse found an advertisement card anchor with no href and therefore not crawlable; it also found unnamed links. Viewport and robots otherwise passed.
Public homepage, category and detail paths returned indexable markup with canonical links; robots.txt and sitemap endpoints returned successfully, and the 404 returned HTTP 404 with noindex.

checkOutcomes.method: metadata probe on homepage and detail route
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage includes Open Graph and JSON-LD, but the representative video detail page had no JSON-LD despite representing a rich VideoObject-like entity.
HTTPS, HSTS and nosniff are present, but Content-Security-Policy and Referrer-Policy are missing.
The tracker probe observed 29 third-party origins; the HAR attributed 33 requests and 284,287 transferred bytes to third parties, including visitor and device fingerprint parameters.

checkOutcomes.method: form DOM and security header inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The site exposes password login but no WebAuthn/passkey surface; username and password fields omit autocomplete tokens. Permissions-Policy does block camera, microphone and geolocation.
HSTS, SAMEORIGIN, nosniff and a restrictive Permissions-Policy are present, but CSP/frame-ancestors and Referrer-Policy are absent.
Raw HTML retained 95% of homepage content words and 92% of detail content words, including title, H1 and descriptions; neither page is a JS shell.
Two fixed cross-origin offer frames use maximum z-index and occupy large viewport regions; Lighthouse also observed an incomplete iframe navigation that prevents BFCache.
This is a public media/content MPA rather than an installed application; no offline transactional flow was identified. Core no-JavaScript resilience was still tested separately.
checkOutcomes.reason: This is a public media/content MPA rather than an installed application; no offline transactional flow was identified. Core no-JavaScript resilience was still tested separately.

checkOutcomes.evidence: A real 404 response renders a clear Page not found state, Return to Home action, and alternative content rather than a blank shell.
The HTML declares en-US and the English content/reading order is coherent; no bidirectional user-generated text surface was found.
The audited public surfaces do not present locale-sensitive dates, currency, calendars, or editable numeric data; view counts and media durations are invariant content metadata.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited public surfaces do not present locale-sensitive dates, currency, calendars, or editable numeric data; view counts and media durations are invariant content metadata.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No schedules, event times, recurring intervals, or user-entered time values appear on the representative paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No schedules, event times, recurring intervals, or user-entered time values appear on the representative paths.

checkOutcomes.method: overlay geometry and Lighthouse crawlable-anchor evidence
checkOutcomes.evidence: Two fixed third-party frames titled offer use maximum z-index and overlap content, while an empty advertisement anchor can be mistaken for a content card.
Submitting the empty complaint form shows field-specific messages only after interaction, marks invalid fields, and connects errors with aria-describedby, plus a concise form-level message.
Login username/password and reset fields omit autocomplete values, so browsers and password managers receive no sign-in/reset assistance.

checkOutcomes.method: login form and platform capability inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The available account flow is password-only, has no passkey option, and omits sign-in autocomplete tokens; no subscription or checkout flow was present.
Of 46 images, 45 use legacy formats, seven are oversized, 12 below-fold images are not lazy-loaded, and two lack dimensions.
The page loads 29 third-party origins and large push/ad/payment bundles; Lighthouse estimated 235 KiB unused JavaScript.
Third parties account for 33 requests and 284,287 transferred bytes, while total load is 71 requests and 864,372 bytes before playing any media.
This public browse-only media site exposes no agent-facing transactional or productivity capability that would justify WebMCP tooling.
checkOutcomes.reason: This public browse-only media site exposes no agent-facing transactional or productivity capability that would justify WebMCP tooling.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation, authoring, translation, classification, or other inference task was identified where on-device AI would improve the core browsing journey.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation, authoring, translation, classification, or other inference task was identified where on-device AI would improve the core browsing journey.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten representative full-page down/up scroll cycles, heap self size differed by 132,143 bytes (0.88%) and node count by 1,433 (0.62%) between fresh-session snapshots, with no unbounded-growth signal.
The baseline heap was 15,013,486 self-size bytes across 231,878 snapshot nodes, proportionate to this media listing and stable in the comparison.

checkOutcomes.method: before/after heap totals with explicit confidence limit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The repeated-scroll comparison stayed within 0.88% heap and 0.62% node deltas, providing no accumulation signal; separate-session snapshots limit attribution of detached constructors and listeners.

principleOutcomes.reason: This public browse-only media site exposes no agent-facing transactional or productivity capability that would justify WebMCP tooling. No summarisation, authoring, translation, classification, or other inference task was identified where on-device AI would improve the core browsing journey.

paths.description: Homepage listing and global shell, including age assurance, preferences, mobile layout, performance, security and memory.
Category index archetype and mobile navigation.
Representative video detail/content page and crawler visibility.
Safety-critical content complaint form and invalid submission recovery.

findings.summary: Emulated dark preference left color-scheme as normal and the body at rgb(238,238,238) with rgb(51,51,51) text..
findings.evidence: Emulated dark preference left color-scheme as normal and the body at rgb(238,238,238) with rgb(51,51,51) text.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and preference-driven surface tokens.

findings.summary: Two 5.5 second animations remained active under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce..
findings.evidence: Two 5.5 second animations remained active under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential animation in a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce media query.

findings.summary: Under prefers-contrast: more the page retained its normal palette, while Lighthouse separately found text ratios as low as 2.27:1..
findings.evidence: Under prefers-contrast: more the page retained its normal palette, while Lighthouse separately found text ratios as low as 2.27:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations and verify essential UI contrast.

findings.summary: The MPA exposes route and filter changes but platform inspection found no authored view-transition CSS or navigation transition treatment..
findings.evidence: The MPA exposes route and filter changes but platform inspection found no authored view-transition CSS or navigation transition treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-origin navigation with @view-transition and stable view-transition-name values.

findings.summary: The homepage is over 4,000 CSS pixels tall, but CSS inspection found no scroll-state query, scroll timeline, or progress treatment; chrome remains static..
findings.evidence: The homepage is over 4,000 CSS pixels tall, but CSS inspection found no scroll-state query, scroll timeline, or progress treatment; chrome remains static.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a lightweight scroll-state-aware header or progress affordance where it helps orientation.

findings.summary: Load screenshots are fully obscured by a verification interstitial, and DOM inspection also found two fixed offer frames at z-index 2147483647 occupying 343 by 255 pixels.
findings.evidence: Load screenshots are fully obscured by a verification interstitial, and DOM inspection also found two fixed offer frames at z-index 2147483647 occupying 343 by 255 pixels. Age assurance is legitimate, but the additional fixed offers are not content-first.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep required age assurance focused and remove or defer unrelated fixed offer overlays until explicit user action.

findings.summary: The login UI is an ad-hoc div with role=dialog and manual Bootstrap dismissal rather than a native dialog; fixed third-party offer frames are also custom top-layer UI..
findings.evidence: The login UI is an ad-hoc div with role=dialog and manual Bootstrap dismissal rather than a native dialog; fixed third-party offer frames are also custom top-layer UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native dialog for login and platform dismissal semantics for transient UI.

findings.summary: Two fixed offer frames and a persistent domain banner compete with page content, with the offer frames using the maximum z-index..
findings.evidence: Two fixed offer frames and a persistent domain banner compete with page content, with the offer frames using the maximum z-index.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove high-z-index advertising chrome and reserve persistent chrome for essential status only.

findings.summary: CSS feature inspection found no @container or container-type usage for repeated video cards and navigation components..
findings.evidence: CSS feature inspection found no @container or container-type usage for repeated video cards and navigation components.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container queries where cards and controls are reused in differently sized regions.

findings.summary: Lighthouse found undersized touch targets, including a 151 by 16 pixel footer link, and the platform probe counted 15 rendered controls below 24 pixels in one dimension..
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found undersized touch targets, including a 151 by 16 pixel footer link, and the platform probe counted 15 rendered controls below 24 pixels in one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target boxes and spacing while retaining the visible keyboard focus treatment.

findings.summary: Lighthouse measured LCP 6.8 seconds and the trace measured LCP 5.10 seconds; TBT was low and CLS was zero, but LCP is outside the good range..
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 6.8 seconds and the trace measured LCP 5.10 seconds; TBT was low and CLS was zero, but LCP is outside the good range.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the real LCP resource and defer third-party work until after meaningful content.

findings.summary: The HAR found 71 requests, six very-high-priority parser stylesheets, parser-inserted scripts without async/defer, and third-party requests taking up to 9.0 seconds..
findings.evidence: The HAR found 71 requests, six very-high-priority parser stylesheets, parser-inserted scripts without async/defer, and third-party requests taking up to 9.0 seconds.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical scripts and ads, consolidate critical CSS, and shorten the LCP dependency path.

findings.summary: Lighthouse estimated 235 KiB unused JavaScript and 11 KiB unused CSS; multiple push, ad, payment and challenge bundles dominate the waste..
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 235 KiB unused JavaScript and 11 KiB unused CSS; multiple push, ad, payment and challenge bundles dominate the waste.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused integrations and conditionally load third-party bundles only when their feature is requested.

findings.summary: Lighthouse found two focusable links without discernible names; the image audit also found two images without alt text..
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found two focusable links without discernible names; the image audit also found two images without alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every actionable link an accessible name and mark decorative ad pixels appropriately.

findings.summary: Lighthouse found repeated 12 px metadata at 4.47:1 and green ratings at only 2.27:1 against white..
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found repeated 12 px metadata at 4.47:1 and green ratings at only 2.27:1 against white.
findings.suggestedFix: Use darker metadata and rating colors that meet WCAG contrast at their rendered size.

findings.summary: Viewport reflow succeeds, but Lighthouse failed target size and found a 151 by 16 pixel footer link with inadequate spacing..
findings.evidence: Viewport reflow succeeds, but Lighthouse failed target size and found a 151 by 16 pixel footer link with inadequate spacing.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise minimum target height and spacing to at least the Lighthouse/WCAG target-size bar.

findings.summary: Lighthouse captured a failed third-party resource with ERR_RESPONSE_HEADERS_MULTIPLE_LOCATION..
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured a failed third-party resource with ERR_RESPONSE_HEADERS_MULTIPLE_LOCATION.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or repair the failing third-party integration and monitor console/network errors in production.

findings.summary: The document has a valid doctype and charset, but the image audit found two missing dimensions, seven oversized images, 45 legacy-format images and two missing alt values..
findings.evidence: The document has a valid doctype and charset, but the image audit found two missing dimensions, seven oversized images, 45 legacy-format images and two missing alt values.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic dimensions and deliver appropriately sized modern image variants.

findings.summary: Lighthouse reported the page was not eligible for BFCache because an iframe navigation never completed; the page also loads many fragile cross-origin frames..
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported the page was not eligible for BFCache because an iframe navigation never completed; the page also loads many fragile cross-origin frames.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unstable iframe navigations and load third-party frames only when visible and needed.

findings.summary: Lighthouse found an advertisement card anchor with no href and therefore not crawlable; it also found unnamed links.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found an advertisement card anchor with no href and therefore not crawlable; it also found unnamed links. Viewport and robots otherwise passed.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href values and descriptive text for every navigational link; do not wrap ad placeholders in empty anchors.

findings.summary: The homepage includes Open Graph and JSON-LD, but the representative video detail page had no JSON-LD despite representing a rich VideoObject-like entity..
findings.evidence: The homepage includes Open Graph and JSON-LD, but the representative video detail page had no JSON-LD despite representing a rich VideoObject-like entity.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD and matching social-preview image metadata to detail pages.

findings.summary: HTTPS, HSTS and nosniff are present, but Content-Security-Policy and Referrer-Policy are missing..
findings.evidence: HTTPS, HSTS and nosniff are present, but Content-Security-Policy and Referrer-Policy are missing.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP and a privacy-preserving Referrer-Policy, then tighten allowed third parties.

findings.summary: The tracker probe observed 29 third-party origins; the HAR attributed 33 requests and 284,287 transferred bytes to third parties, including visitor and device fingerprint parameters..
findings.evidence: The tracker probe observed 29 third-party origins; the HAR attributed 33 requests and 284,287 transferred bytes to third parties, including visitor and device fingerprint parameters.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove non-essential ad/tracking vendors, minimise fingerprinting data, and gate optional third parties behind explicit choice.

findings.summary: The site exposes password login but no WebAuthn/passkey surface; username and password fields omit autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: The site exposes password login but no WebAuthn/passkey surface; username and password fields omit autocomplete tokens. Permissions-Policy does block camera, microphone and geolocation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add correct sign-in autocomplete tokens and offer passkeys for registered accounts.

findings.summary: HSTS, SAMEORIGIN, nosniff and a restrictive Permissions-Policy are present, but CSP/frame-ancestors and Referrer-Policy are absent..
findings.evidence: HSTS, SAMEORIGIN, nosniff and a restrictive Permissions-Policy are present, but CSP/frame-ancestors and Referrer-Policy are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Add CSP with frame-ancestors and a strict referrer policy while preserving existing HSTS and permissions restrictions.

findings.summary: Two fixed cross-origin offer frames use maximum z-index and occupy large viewport regions; Lighthouse also observed an incomplete iframe navigation that prevents BFCache..
findings.evidence: Two fixed cross-origin offer frames use maximum z-index and occupy large viewport regions; Lighthouse also observed an incomplete iframe navigation that prevents BFCache.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unstable offer frames and use bounded, dismissible platform overlays that cannot cover core content.

findings.summary: Two fixed third-party frames titled offer use maximum z-index and overlap content, while an empty advertisement anchor can be mistaken for a content card..
findings.evidence: Two fixed third-party frames titled offer use maximum z-index and overlap content, while an empty advertisement anchor can be mistaken for a content card.
findings.suggestedFix: Clearly separate and label advertising, eliminate disguised empty cards, and never force unrelated offers over content.

findings.summary: Login username/password and reset fields omit autocomplete values, so browsers and password managers receive no sign-in/reset assistance..
findings.evidence: Login username/password and reset fields omit autocomplete values, so browsers and password managers receive no sign-in/reset assistance.
findings.suggestedFix: Use username and current-password autocomplete tokens and appropriate email tokens on account forms.

findings.summary: The available account flow is password-only, has no passkey option, and omits sign-in autocomplete tokens; no subscription or checkout flow was present..
findings.evidence: The available account flow is password-only, has no passkey option, and omits sign-in autocomplete tokens; no subscription or checkout flow was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Support passkeys and standards-based autofill while keeping account recovery clear and reversible.

findings.summary: Of 46 images, 45 use legacy formats, seven are oversized, 12 below-fold images are not lazy-loaded, and two lack dimensions..
findings.evidence: Of 46 images, 45 use legacy formats, seven are oversized, 12 below-fold images are not lazy-loaded, and two lack dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, right-size srcset candidates, lazy-load below-fold media and set dimensions.

findings.summary: The page loads 29 third-party origins and large push/ad/payment bundles; Lighthouse estimated 235 KiB unused JavaScript..
findings.evidence: The page loads 29 third-party origins and large push/ad/payment bundles; Lighthouse estimated 235 KiB unused JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused vendors and schedule optional background fetching only after explicit need.

findings.summary: Third parties account for 33 requests and 284,287 transferred bytes, while total load is 71 requests and 864,372 bytes before playing any media..
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 33 requests and 284,287 transferred bytes, while total load is 71 requests and 864,372 bytes before playing any media.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, defer ads/push/payment code, and retain only vendors with measurable user value.

taskList.title: Remove intrusive and wasteful third-party overlays and trackers
Fix slow LCP and defer non-critical delivery
Repair accessibility names, contrast and target sizes
Respect dark, motion and contrast preferences
Harden CSP and browser security policies
Optimise image formats, dimensions and loading
Improve account autofill and passkey support
Modernise overlays, responsive components and transitions
